{{short description|Danish mathematician}}
[[File:Ib Madsen.jpeg|thumb|Ib Madsen in [[Oberwolfach]], 2008]]
'''Ib Henning Madsen''' (born 12 April 1942, in [[Copenhagen]])<ref name="cv">[https://www.math.ku.dk/~imadsen/cv.pdf Curriculum vitae], retrieved 3 February 2013.</ref> is a Danish mathematician, a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Copenhagen]]. He is known for (with [[Michael Weiss (mathematician)|Michael Weiss]]) proving the Mumford conjecture on the [[cohomology]] of the stable [[mapping class group]], and for developing topological [[cyclic homology]] theory.<ref name="ostrowski"/>

==Professional career==
Madsen earned a candidate degree from the University of Copenhagen in 1965, and a Ph.D. from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1970 under the supervision of [[J. Peter May]].<ref name="cv"/><ref name="ostrowski"/><ref name="mg">{{mathgenealogy|name=Ib Henning Madsen|id=6627}}</ref> In 1971 he took a faculty position at [[Aarhus University]], and he remained there until 2008, when he moved to Copenhagen.<ref name="cv"/><ref name="ostrowski"/>

His doctoral students have included [[Søren Galatius]] and [[Lars Hesselholt]].<ref name="mg"/>

==Awards and honors==
Madsen was elected as a member of the [[Royal Danish Academy of Science and Letters]] in 1978,<ref>[http://www.royalacademy.dk/Danske.aspx?ID=33&userid=611 Member profile], [[Royal Danish Academy of Science and Letters]], retrieved 3 February 2013.</ref> as a foreign member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] in 1998,<ref name="cv"/><ref>[http://www.kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=2104 Member profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211220064956/https://www.kva.se/en/contact/Kontakt-sida/?personId=2104 |date=20 December 2021 }}, [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]], retrieved 3 February 2013.</ref> and as a foreign member of the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]] in 2000.<ref name="cv"/><ref>[http://www.dknvs.no/akademimedlemmer/medlemmer/utenlandske-medlemmer-naturvitenskapelig-klasse/ Foreign members of science class] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131222003839/http://www.dknvs.no/akademimedlemmer/medlemmer/utenlandske-medlemmer-naturvitenskapelig-klasse/ |date=22 December 2013 }} (in Norwegian), [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]], retrieved 4 February 2013.</ref> In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2 February 2013.</ref>

In 1992, he was awarded the [[Humboldt Prize]].<ref name="cv"/> In 2011, he won the [[Ostrowski Prize]] for outstanding achievement in pure 
mathematics, shared with [[Kannan Soundararajan]] and [[David Preiss]].<ref name="ostrowski">{{citation|title=2011 Ostrowski Prize Awarded|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|volume=59|issue=8|pages=1110–1111|date=September 2012|first=Elaine|last=Kehoe|doi=10.1090/noti889|doi-access=free}}.</ref>
